output.text: My sister lives in the rich hamlets. I have not heard from her since the shaking. Nobody up there answers their phone. Is anyone going up there?
Calls keep dropping near the market. Everyone is trying to reach relatives in the villages. Can you tell me F.Y. Lachoy has been reached by anyone?
Hi, it's me, I'm at the market. Everything is still shaking a bit. Are the kids home? Okay, good. Keep them there. I'll come back now.
My father fell from the ladder when it started. His leg has bent the wrong way and he is bleeding a lot. We are on the main road next to the bakery. Please send an ambulance.
Hello, is this the town hall? I wanted to ask if the school will be open tomorrow, and whether the market will run on Saturday.
This is the fire station dispatcher on a mobile phone. Our radio console is down. I need to reach the mountain rescue coordinator about the pass road operation.
Mum, I'm stuck in traffic on the way out of town. Everybody is leaving at once. I'm fine. I'll call you when I get to Aunt Layla's.
My neighbor is diabetic and she ran out of insulin this morning. Now she is confused and very weak. We are near the Moscon Station Road.

Base. This is Mountain Rescue Unit 2 at Kilometer 14 on the pass road. Landslide covered the road. At least one car buried. We can hear a horn. We lose radio contact beyond the bend. We need a relay. Over.
Unit 2. One person extracted from the buried car. Hypothermic but alive. A second vehicle may be under the debris. Unconfirmed. Over.
